exposure.needed: whether the environment manages CRDs separately from the Crossplane release or relies on bundled CRD installation

original.statement: A new CRD for ManagedResourceDefinition (managedresourcedefinitions.apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1alpha1) was added and must be installed before upgrading if CRDs are managed separately from the release.

decision.reason: [ev-270c9e3fe130] shows the ManagedResourceDefinition CRD in v2.0.0, and it does not appear in the v1.20.1 CRD set [ev-95c4d9181c78, ev-4cb106f172c6]. The validator confirmed it is new in the target release. The change text's only exposure condition is "if you manage them separately from the release". No Helm value, manifest or rendered object in the evidence shows how CRDs are managed. The render validator found it "not visible with chart defaults", and no canonical exposure condition exists for an added gvk. So the proposed undecidable condition (environment-visibility-gap) about separate CRD management matches the stated exposure without making it broader or narrower.
